scope: Current 79 tracked CAPCOM AppIDs; not all titles ever published by CAPCOM
edition_policy: User permits complete base-game editions to continue by AppID across version changes; single chapters and cross-game bundle-only periods are excluded
inference: Historical list prices are inferred from reviewed event transitions and recurring price ceilings. Original exports contain only Final price, not initial/list price or purchase package identity. No official historical discount or package identity is asserted.
price_rule: Binary sale is final price below reviewed period baseline. max_discount_percent is rounded from price ratio and may differ from Steam advertised integer discounts.
zero_rule: Zero and blank prices mean unknown; no interpolation beyond last source timestamp
